newWeb.required: Real format2 immutable artifactId/sourceHead/manifestDigest/releaseId + artifactRoot and exact root/dist identities + manifest pin. Supplied bytes/capacity must match public release verifier.

correctedBackend.required: Immutable backend artifact descriptor at the same exact source, directory/root/sourceTree/Node and complete admitted runtime pins; must include corrected logout behavior. No 6c/7d1 substitution.

retainedApps: The exact existing three immutable Apps and their Bearer path remain; their four-check reports must be newly produced against the same newly supplied backend/context. Historical 6c reports cannot be relabelled.
nextAfterSupply: Bind only changed caller/inputs and finite resource proposal; focused lifecycle review then manager actual handoff. No repeat of this strict or unrelated old checks.
visiblePublish: Original publication action not performed by this owner; current source approval is not main/deployment/compatibility approval.
